jobs.prompt: Use case: character-design. Create a NEW portrait of RUAN XIAOQI from the 120-chapter Water Margin, not the person in the reference. Reference is ONLY painterly rendering, parchment background and square bust composition; DO NOT COPY its face, red clothes or cap. Novel ch15 literal face: broad rugged irregular fleshy facial contours (疙疸脸横生怪肉), prominent protruding alert eyes, patchy uneven pale yellow/light ochre whiskers along jaw and cheeks, visible scattered natural dark skin spots on exposed arms/skin (not tattoos). A vigorous weathered adult Chinese fisherman, rough and fearless, mischievous direct gaze, natural human proportions. NOT a handsome young scholar, NOT a demon, no invented wound, scar, pox crater, black beard or ethnic caricature. Chapter19 combat clothes: old blue-green woven bamboo/reed sunhat with a shallow conical wide brim (青箬笠), plain green straw/reed rain cape (绿蓑衣) with coarse layered fibers, coarse small black/cream checked sleeveless cloth vest showing a little neckline underneath. Hat angled up enough that BOTH protruding eyes, full face and the uneven straw-yellow beard are clearly visible. Hat fits within square canvas with margins, bust to chest framing. Natural sun-weathered warm skin, no magical aura, armor, trident, scythe, dragon robes, decorative insignia or text. Same refined historically inspired brush-painted realism as reference, sharp detailed large readable face, warm neutral parchment background. Face/costume continuity will anchor subsequent game sprites. Exact hat/cape weave, colors and facial anatomy are conservative rendering of the text, no claim of literal portraiture.

Use case: character-design. Create a game sprite atlas for EXACT same RUAN XIAOQI as reference portrait. Preserve its broad irregular rugged human face, protruding alert eyes, uneven pale yellow whiskers, dark natural skin spots on exposed skin, old blue-green woven conical wide-brim reed/bamboo sunhat, plain coarse green straw rain cape tied with simple cord, small black/cream checker cloth sleeveless vest. Full-body sturdy weathered Chinese fisherman, NO armor. Add plain raw beige linen waist wrap/apron to knees, rolled dull grey trousers and bare feet (conservative practical costume fill). ONE slender plain straight wooden pole spear with small narrow iron leaf point (笔管枪), NO trident/fork/hook/scythe/extra knife. Natural ready standing, two hands on spear around waist, spear diagonally down-forward for each facing with full tip/butt visible. Painterly historically inspired realism matching portrait. Four independently drawn directions in exact 2x2: upper-left SE/front-right, upper-right SW/front-left, lower-left NE/back-right, lower-right NW/back-left. Iso elevated camera, all four body heights equal, no mirroring of asymmetrical features, each complete body and hat and whole spear inside its quadrant with generous empty gutters at center and external edge. Neutral standing feet grounded, no running pose, no magic/glow/water effects. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no shadows, text, borders, scenery or extra person/props. Clear cape silhouette made of plant fibers, NOT plate armor. Keep face visible below brim in front views. No drawn sea monster, tattoo, permanent scar or supernatural features. This will be the master identity for idle and future walk/attack/hurt/fall frames.
